method: Built-in image_gen only; 13 initial generations plus 2 targeted corrections
usageNotes: Generated design concepts based on plan. Use preferred list below; initial versions 07-bedroom4.png and 13-utility.png are retained for review. Compass offsets are visual estimates only; altered geometry means not all opening positions can align with one yaw. bestInitialU is normalized horizontal image position, with 0.5 image centre.
globalQualityNotes: Every PNG visually inspected and dimensions independently measured with System.Drawing. Images have 2:1 layout and curved equirectangular-looking ceiling/floor bands, but no ray-traced camera geometry, measured seams, or surveyed accuracy. Plan room content is broadly represented with material/style consistency. Several secondary beds are wider or rotated relative to the plan; exterior openings and facade are conceptual.
